questions.question: In the wilderness, why could some Israelite men not observe the Passover on the day God appointed?

answers.text: They were unclean because of a dead body
They were serving at the Tent of Meeting
They had no lamb for the meal

questions.question: Some men were unclean and asked Moses why they should miss the Passover offering. What did Moses tell them?

answers.text: Wait until he found out what the LORD commands
Sit out this year and try again next year
Wash their clothes and join in that night

questions.question: God said Israelites who were unclean or away on a journey could observe the Passover later. In which month?
What did God say would happen to a clean Israelite who was not traveling but still failed to observe the Passover?

answers.text: He would be cut off from his people
He would keep it the next month instead
He would bring a double offering next year
